## About this page

What a new password looks like: the type and length the generator starts with, and what it shows about strength.

#### How it works

These are starting values. The generator opens with them each time, and changes you make on the generator itself last until you leave it.

Only the settings the chosen **Type** uses are shown: **Length**, **Symbols** and **Avoid look-alikes** for Random, and **Words** for Words.

The same settings make the password that [Start logins with a password](/guide/settings/editor/#setting-editor-generate) fills in for a new login.

#### On Android

These are starting values. The generator opens with them each time, and changes you make on the generator itself last until you leave it.

The same settings make the password that [Start logins with a password](/guide/settings/editor/#setting-editor-generate) fills in for a new login.

See also [Generator screen](/guide/screens/#screen-generator), [Generated passwords](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-generator).

<a id="setting-gen-mode"></a>

## Type

Which kind of secret the generator makes first.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Random | Letters, digits and symbols chosen at random, with at least one of each kind you allow. |
| Words | Random words from a list of 7,776, joined by dashes, with a number. Easier to remember and to type. |
| Pronounceable | Pairs of a consonant and a vowel, easy to say aloud and type. |
| PIN | Digits only. |
| Pattern | Follows a template you type, for sites with fixed rules. |

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

#### On Android

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Random | Letters, digits and symbols chosen at random, with at least one of each kind you allow. |
| Words | Random words from a list of 7,776, joined by dashes, with a number. Easier to remember and to type. |
| Pronounceable | Pairs of a consonant and a vowel, easy to say aloud and type. |
| PIN | Digits only. |
| Pattern | Follows a template you type, for sites with fixed rules. |
| Lock pattern | A path through the dots of a phone's lock screen grid, drawn and written out for you to copy. |

See also [Length](/guide/settings/generator/#setting-gen-length), [Words](/guide/settings/generator/#setting-gen-words).

<a id="setting-gen-length"></a>

## Length

How many characters a random password starts with.

#### How it works

With letters, digits and symbols, each character adds about 6.4 bits of strength, so 20 characters give about 129 bits. On the generator itself you can drag the length anywhere from 8 to 64.

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

See also [Show strength in bits](/guide/settings/generator/#setting-gen-show-bits), [Type](/guide/settings/generator/#setting-gen-mode).

<a id="setting-gen-words"></a>

## Words

How many words a passphrase starts with.

#### How it works

Each word adds about 12.9 bits of strength, so four words give about 52 before the number is added. Four is what most people can remember.

See also [Type](/guide/settings/generator/#setting-gen-mode), [Show strength in bits](/guide/settings/generator/#setting-gen-show-bits).

<a id="setting-gen-symbols"></a>

## Symbols

Adds symbols such as ! @ # $ to random passwords.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| On | Every random password has at least one symbol. |
| Off | Letters and digits only, for sites that refuse symbols. |

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

<a id="setting-gen-no-ambiguous"></a>

## Avoid look-alikes

Leaves characters that are easy to confuse, such as 0 and O or 1, l and I, out of random passwords.

#### When to use it

For a password you will read off a screen and type by hand, such as on a television or a new phone.

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

#### Limits

It takes six characters out of the choice, so each character adds a little less strength.

See also [Color digits and symbols](/guide/settings/entry/#setting-colour-secrets).

<a id="setting-gen-show-bits"></a>

## Show strength in bits

Shows how many bits of strength the generated value has, beside the time it would take to crack.

#### How it works

Bits count how many results these settings could have given, not how this one looks. Each extra bit doubles the guesses someone would need.

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

See also [Length](/guide/settings/generator/#setting-gen-length), [Words](/guide/settings/generator/#setting-gen-words).
